items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: He was around the age with a piano player I know they called Oscar Desdune.

ctx.x: About how old a man was he? Well as they say when you were ten years old, how old was he grown or just a few years

older? No, he was about twenty, twenty-four years old. When you were ten? Yeah, he was about twenty-four then. I know he was quite a young man. He was around the age with a piano player I know they called Oscar Desdune.
